main_text.p: 12 Observet non minus de quibus tacere satius sit in ecclesia & apud populum Dei: quia etiam aliqua e-rudita inscitia est.
13 Perpendat praeterea, quibus argumentis utraque pars sua exponat & confirmet.
14 Attendat quid iisdem verbis, quibus proponitur in scriptura, expressum sit, quibus anima pia simpliciter, tuto, & necessario acquie-scit.
15 Deinde quid exprimatur in scripturis verbis synonymis vel idem significantibus.
16 Similiter etiam, quid ex conse-quenti inde eruatur & cõcludatur.
17 Et contra disspiciat; Quodnam dogma pugnet cum expressis s. scri-pturae testimoniis: aut eorum consequentibus.
18 Atque ita controversa diiudicet ad earundem s. scripturarum amussim & regulam.
19 Ad calumnias autem, probra, invectivas aures atque oculos obsir-met.

page.notes: The page number 133 is printed at the head. The catchword "Postre." is at the lower right, and the signature "I 3" is at the lower left. The cut-off text at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out. Line 17 reads "disspiciat" as printed, and the spelling "Quodnam" and "controversa" is as printed. Some ink is faint in the lower lines, but all words were legible.
